blocks.text: Snyk is a platform that helps developers find and fix vulnerabilities in open-source libraries and containers integrated into their workflows.
There are two available Snyk streams. To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and Snyk Deployment Guide.
To configure the Snyk connector, you need the source authentication configuration. The following parameters are required:

blocks.item: To learn more, see Zscaler UVM and Snyk Deployment Guide.

blocks.text: To create the Snyk data source in the Zscaler Security Operations (SecOps) platform:

blocks.item: Search for and select the connector tile from the available data sources.

blocks.text: After you create the Snyk data source, enter the Authentication information in the source setup Retrieval section. To configure authentication:

blocks.item: In the Authentication section, click Create New.
In the Snyk Authentication window, enter the information from the Prerequisites section.

blocks.text: To learn more, see Configuring Authentications and Managing Authentications.
For complete configuration instructions, see Creating Data Sources.
